thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sev2 - Failures observed with GitHub Actions and Packages API. CI jobs queuing + package fetch errors; oncall paged.

sre-alex: Acknowledged. I'm looking at the CI dashboard. Multiple workflow runners report jobs stuck in 'queued' and package fetches returning 502/504 from packages.github.com. Hotfix pipeline for release/patch-2026.03.15 cannot complete.

eng-release-lee: Confirming. npm install of @redwood/common failed with 504 from GitHub Packages. The GH Actions runners can't pull private packages so we can't produce the artifact to push.

eng-platform-kim: Triage: check GitHub status page and support. Workarounds: (A) use internal npm mirror (artifactory/jfrog) if copies exist; (B) build on our on-prem CI which can pull from internal caches; (C) assemble image from cached docker layers and patch app code inside container.

deploy-bot: Autodeploy blocked - no new artifact available to roll. Manual path required for emergency patch.

customer-success-rita: We have a P1 from AcmeCorp reporting the issue that the hotfix addresses (embeddings regression). They're on hold and asking for an ETA.

product-ops-jordan: Prioritize AcmeCorp. If manual deploy short-circuits the issue, do it. Make sure CS has a clear status update.

sre-alex: I'll open a GitHub support escalation now. Can someone validate if we have a recent mirror of @redwood/common in artifactory? If not, we'll need to vendor the dependency.

eng-release-lee: I can start a build on jenkins-runner-02 which has access to our internal npm mirror and docker cache. If that succeeds, we can push an emergency image to gcr.redwood-inference/prod/emergency:patch-20260315.

eng-platform-kim: If you're pushing that image I'll prepare a controlled canary rollout and a temporary feature-flag to reduce blast radius. Also I will hold alerts to avoid noisy pages for CI queue stalls but keep production error pages active.

sre-alex: Opening GH ticket now. GH-TICKET-20260315-01 created. Submitting logs + request for priority. Linking status: https://www.githubstatus.com/ (monitoring).

eng-release-lee: Starting build on jenkins-runner-02. Commands I'm running:

```
git checkout release/patch-2026.03.15
# use internal registry to avoid hitting GitHub Packages
npm ci --registry=https://internal-mirror.redwood/artifactory/api/npm/npm/
npm run build
docker build -t gcr.redwood-inference/prod/emergency:patch-20260315 .
docker push gcr.redwood-inference/prod/emergency:patch-20260315
# then k8s rollout
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=gcr.redwood-inference/prod/emergency:patch-20260315 --record
```

deploy-bot: Jenkins job jenkins/patch-20260315 #58 queued.

eng-release-lee: Build finished. Image pushed: gcr.redwood-inference/prod/emergency:patch-20260315 (digest sha256:deadbeefcafebabe...). Note: I had to fetch a tarball fallback for @redwood/common from our blobstore because packages.github.com timed out.

eng-platform-kim: Initiating canary in prod-canary. Watching latency, error-rate, and traces. Rolling out to ~2% first.

sre-alex: Monitoring SLO dashboards and logs. If canary stays within thresholds for 10m, proceed to broader rollout. Keeping a fast rollback plan ready.

product-ops-jordan: Notifying AcmeCorp: "We are deploying an emergency patch; estimated 25-40 minutes to full rollout if canary looks good."

customer-success-rita: AcmeCorp acknowledged and is on standby. They're asking for post-deploy verification steps.

eng-platform-kim: Canary at +7m: metrics look stable. No spike in 5xx or latency. Proceeding to incremental rollout.

deploy-bot: Prod rollout: rollout-id r-20260315-emer-1 started.

sre-alex: Rollout progressing, watching for error regressions and tail latency. If regression seen, pause and rollback to previous image.

eng-release-lee: After prod rollout, I pushed the artifact tarball into our internal mirror so devs aren't blocked. Still cannot publish to GitHub Packages due to the outage.

sre-alex: GitHub support updated the ticket: "We are experiencing partial outage affecting packages endpoints; mitigation in progress." No ETA yet. Ticket GH-TICKET-20260315-01 updated with our logs.

eng-platform-kim: Post-rollout smoke checks pass. I'll create a short emergency runbook doc with the exact commands used and publish to the runbooks repo. We should add this flow to oncall playbooks.

product-ops-jordan: Agreed. Codify steps & checklist (CS comms, metrics to watch, rollback criteria).

sre-alex: Handoff: I'm going offline in ~15m. Handoff to @sre-maya. Summary for handoff: GitHub Actions/Packages partial outage prevented GH Actions runners from pulling private packages; workaround executed by building on on-prem CI (jenkins) using internal mirror and blob fallbacks, pushed emergency image to GCR, deployed via canary->prod; AcmeCorp P1 notified. Open items: follow-up with GH support, publish canonical package to GH Packages after recovery, add runbook, file postmortem.

sre-maya: Ack. I'll take monitoring, keep pages for prod regressions enabled, and coordinate the postmortem. Please paste any artifacts or job links before you go.

eng-release-lee: Links: jenkins job https://ci.redwood/jenkins/job/patch-20260315/58, image digest sha256:deadbeefcafebabe..., internal mirror artifact: https://artifactory.internal/redwood/@redwood/common/-/common-1.2.3.tgz

customer-success-rita: I'll debrief AcmeCorp after we confirm prod stability. Will offer a brief timeline and next steps for the permanent fix.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: transitioned -> monitoring. Please file a postmortem and tag with incident-id 2026-03-15-gh-packages-01.

sre-maya: Taking over monitoring and will schedule the postmortem invite for next week with eng-release, eng-platform, cs, and product.
